Cognitive Patterns — How Great Eng Managers Think
Engineering Management Canon (Larson, McKinley, Fowler, Brooks, Google SRE, Team Topologies, Beck, Majors)
ASCII Test Coverage Diagram (code paths + user flows)
E2E Test Decision Matrix (unit vs E2E vs eval)
Outside Voice — Independent Cross-Model Plan Challenge
Rationale: two AI models agreeing is stronger signal than one model's thorough review
ASCII Diagrams in Plans and Code Comments
Rationale: stale diagrams are worse than no diagrams — they actively mislead
QA Diff-Aware Mode (branch diff → affected pages)
QA Fix Loop (locate → fix → atomic commit → re-verify)
Rationale: stop runaway fix loops — reverts and unrelated file touches signal loss of control
Test Framework Bootstrap (detect runtime, install, TESTING.md, CI)
QA Health Score Rubric (weighted category scores)
CDP Mode (browse connected to real browser)
Rationale: report-only separation — never fix, never read source; use /qa for the fix loop
QA Issue Categories (Visual, Functional, UX, Content, Performance, Console, Accessibility)
Greptile Signal Metric (catch vs false-positive ratio)
Enum & Value Completeness (read consumers outside the diff)
Rationale: mechanical fixes a senior engineer would apply without discussion → AUTO-FIX; anything reasonable engineers could disagree on → ASK
AI Slop Detection (purple gradients, 3-column grids, centered everything)
Rationale: telltale signs of AI-generated UI no designer at a respected studio would ship
DESIGN.md Calibration (project design system overrides universal rules)
Greptile Reply Templates (Tier 1 friendly / Tier 2 firm, evidence required)
CLAUDE.md as Project Config Source of Truth
Rationale: small logical commits serve git bisect and help LLMs understand what changed; each commit independently valid
Verification Gate (Iron Law: no completion claims without fresh evidence)
Rationale: claiming work complete without verification is dishonesty, not efficiency — confidence is not evidence
Test Failure Ownership Triage (in-branch vs pre-existing)
Eval Suites Gate (mandatory on prompt-file changes, EVAL_JUDGE_TIER=full)
Coverage Gate (minimum/target thresholds with user override)
Plan Verification (Step 3.47, /qa-only inline against dev server)
Distribution Pipeline Check (new artifact needs release workflow)
PR/MR Body Template (Summary, Coverage, Reviews, Plan Completion)
